body.x: ECOPEACE Co., Ltd. (CEO In Won Chae) made waves at CES 2025 in Las Vegas, showcasing its groundbreaking ‘Healing Boat’—a solution that combines water recreation with algae removal for sustainable water management. The Healing Boat, winner of the CES 2025 Innovation Award in the Smart Cities category, highlights the potential of eco-friendly technologies in addressing environmental challenges.

ECOPEACE has earned recognition for its AI-powered autonomous technology and solar energy modules, which underpin its eco-friendly water purification robots. The Healing Boat actively removes algae while generating its energy via solar power, offering a sustainable approach to water resource management. This technology has already been validated through partnerships with public corporations and local governments in South Korea, including deliveries of the ECO-BOT and ECO-STATION products.

The Healing Boat goes beyond environmental technology by incorporating entertainment features. Passengers aboard the autonomous boat can enjoy 3D digital video content, offering a unique experience of underwater ecosystems. This water recreation and resource conservation combination earned the Healing Boat its prestigious CES Innovation Award.

body.cap: ECOPEACE’s ECO-BOT, a water purification robot, on display at CES 2025 | Photo by AVING News

body.x: At CES 2025, ECOPEACE is exploring opportunities in North American and European markets, targeting regions with high demand for freshwater solutions. The company is already in talks for Healing Boat sales in Vietnam and is conducting a proof-of-concept project for a customized water purification robot in Singapore.

In addition to the Healing Boat, ECOPEACE is expanding its product lineup to include oil removal robots, recreational boats, and bubble removal solutions. The company is setting a new sustainable robotics and mobility standard by leveraging autonomous technology and renewable energy.

ECOPEACE CEO In Won Chae stated, “CES 2025 is the perfect platform to showcase our vision to a global audience. We aim to create new business opportunities by collaborating with water resource management agencies and corporations worldwide. The Healing Boat is more than a technological innovation; it’s a vision for a future where environmental protection and enjoyment coexist.”

body.x: AVING News, which has covered CES for 20 consecutive years, continues to support the global ambitions of Korean SMEs and startups through various initiatives.

Before CES 2025, AVING hosted a series of Global Media Meetups featuring aspiring SMEs in Korea. The Meetups introduced Korean SMEs’ technologies, products, and services to media worldwide, expanding connections between the Korean industry and global media. Geekspin, Ubergizmo, Interesting Engineering, and Le Café du Geek participated in these meetups.
During CES 2025, AVING established the AVING Broadcasting Zone at The Venetian Hotel in Las Vegas, interviewing CES Innovation Award 2025 winners.
Following CES 2025, AVING will co-host a review conference with participating companies in Korea, offering them a platform to gain further recognition and enhance their corporate image.
